details: Bitcoin (BTC) is trading in a tight range between $63,310 and $64,500, showing slight declines, while the overall crypto market capitalization is marginally up. Despite lower-than-expected US July CPI data (3.4%), which typically favors risk assets, a sustained rally has been hindered by ongoing geopolitical uncertainty and delays in crypto-related legislation.
title: Bitcoin Consolidates Around $63K Amid Mixed Market & Geopolitical Uncertainty

details: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has scheduled open meetings between August 12-14 to consider proposing new rules for a tailored offering regime specifically for certain crypto investment contracts. This initiative could potentially include a token safe-harbor framework, marking a significant step towards clearer regulatory guidelines for the crypto industry.
title: SEC Schedules Pivotal Votes on New Crypto Asset Rules

details: Harmony's native token, ONE, experienced a severe exploit leading to the unauthorized minting of approximately 4 billion tokens, which accounts for about 26% of its total supply. This incident caused the ONE token's price to drop significantly by 26%. Harmony has confirmed the security breach and is actively working on an emergency patch to address the issue.
title: Harmony Suffers 4 Billion ONE Token Minting Exploit, Price Drops 26%

details: Analysts are now projecting a potential recovery for Ethereum (ETH) to the $2,000 mark, following a period of consolidation above $1,900. Despite a challenging six months for the asset, the recent stabilization has fostered a more positive outlook among market experts, with some forecasting continued upward momentum later in the year.
title: Ethereum Price Prediction Targets $2,000 After Consolidation

details: Despite a nearly 70% price drop for Dogecoin (DOGE) over the past year, speculative futures bets on the memecoin have surged to levels last seen in October 2025. Open interest in DOGE futures contracts now stands at approximately $1.21 billion, with long positions considerably outnumbering shorts, raising concerns about potential liquidations if prices continue to fall.
title: Dogecoin Futures Speculation Reaches 2025 Levels Amidst Price Decline

details: Spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) have continued to attract inflows, with BlackRock's iShares Bitcoin Trust ETF (IBIT) leading the charge with approximately $50 million in inflows yesterday. Overall, Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs collectively experienced their best week since April, recording over $1 billion in total inflows.
title: Spot Bitcoin ETFs See Modest Inflows, BlackRock Leads

details: Corporate treasury firm FG Nexus has divested all of its Ethereum holdings, resulting in a reported $45 million loss, as it pivots its investment strategy towards mobile home parks. The company indicated that its staking rewards only amounted to $144,000 in the first half of 2026.
title: FG Nexus Liquidates Ethereum Holdings for $45M Loss, Shifts to Real Estate
